Title: Announcing General Availability to migrate Virtual Network injected Azure Data Explorer Cluster to Private Endpoints

Body.Content:
We are excited to announce that we have made the migration of Azure Virtual Network injected Azure Data Explorer cluster to Private Endpoints generally available. This feature allows you to migrate your VNet injected ADX cluster to Private Endpoints with minimal downtime and disruption. The migration process is simple and can be done using the Azure portal, the ARM template, or any code which uses the ADX SDK.

To learn more about the migration process, the prerequisites, and the steps to follow, please read our detailed documentation article.
